description: The National Statistics Office of Viet Nam (NSO, the former General Statistics Office) published the completed results of the 2019 Population and Housing Census as a bilingual Vietnamese and English book. Its housing tables give, for the whole country, urban and rural areas, six socio-economic regions and every province and city, the number of households by dwelling status, the share living in permanent, semi-permanent, less permanent and simple houses, floor area per capita, ownership, main water source, main toilet type and household amenities. Nationally 52.2 percent of households used tap water as their main source (84.2 percent urban, 34.8 percent rural) and 22.8 percent used drilled wells; tap water ranged from 20.3 percent in the Central Highlands to 69.1 percent in the Southeast. Format and access: a free PDF of 842 pages and an online census dashboard offering table downloads. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the tables are inside a PDF and need extraction, the dashboard needs JavaScript, and the older gso.gov.vn address no longer answered from the cloud. Simulation uses: provincial housing solidity for typhoon and flood exposure, and piped water coverage for supply planning. Related records: the Thailand census household water tables.
